notes:
## New features & enhancements

- The readout says `UPDATED TO V1.4.12` on the first launch after an update, then returns to the station.
- The console theme strikes its cells whenever the name changes, the way a segment display arrives at something new.
- The installer closes the radio before writing and opens it again afterwards.
- The installer names the version it is replacing, read from the installed copy.
- The update pill fades in over 220ms and out over 90ms.
- Brighter alert orange, the same in both places it appears, on every theme.
- The Service tab carries the update dot as well as the Settings control.
- The next-up chip names the slot that follows a gap or the end of the day.

## Bug fixes

- A profile that cannot be renamed is used rather than replaced with an empty one.
- An existing profile with no recorded version was taken for a first install, so the announcement was skipped.
